subject: math
description: Identify similar figures by checking shape, corresponding angle equality, and proportional side lengths, then write correct similarity statements.
learningObjectives: Recognize that similar figures have the same shape but may have different sizes
Match corresponding vertices, sides, and angles in two figures
Use equal corresponding angles as evidence for similarity
Use proportional corresponding side lengths as evidence for similarity
Reject non-examples where a figure has been distorted instead of scaled
Write similarity statements with vertices in the correct order
prerequisites: Name polygons and vertices in order
Identify corresponding sides and angles from a diagram
Understand that congruent figures have the same shape and the same size
Use geometric notation such as $\triangle ABC$ and $\angle A$
